verses.original: לֹֽא־ יִ֠הְיֶה לַכֹּהֲנִ֨ים הַלְוִיִּ֜ם כָּל־ שֵׁ֧בֶט לֵוִ֛י חֵ֥לֶק וְנַחֲלָ֖ה עִם־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל אִשֵּׁ֧י יְהוָ֛ה וְנַחֲלָת֖וֹ יֹאכֵלֽוּן׃
verses.transliteration: lō- yih·yeh lak·kō·hă·nîm hal·wî·yim kāl- šê·ḇeṭ lê·wî ḥê·leq wə·na·ḥă·lāh ‘im- yiś·rā·’êl ’iš·šê Yah·weh wə·na·ḥă·lā·ṯōw yō·ḵê·lūn
verses.literal: The Levitical priests indeed the whole tribe of Levi shall have no portion or inheritance with Israel They are to eat the food offerings to the LORD that is their inheritance
verses.literalPt: OS sacerdotes levitas, toda a tribo de Levi, não terão parte nem herança com Israel; das ofertas queimadas do SENHOR e da sua herança comerão.

verses.original: וְנַחֲלָ֥ה לֹא־ יִֽהְיֶה־ לּ֖וֹ בְּקֶ֣רֶב אֶחָ֑יו יְהוָה֙ ה֣וּא נַחֲלָת֔וֹ כַּאֲשֶׁ֖ר דִּבֶּר־ לֽוֹ׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·na·ḥă·lāh lō- yih·yeh- lōw bə·qe·reḇ ’e·ḥāw Yah·weh hū na·ḥă·lā·ṯōw ka·’ă·šer dib·ber- lōw
verses.literal: Although they have no inheritance among their brothers the LORD . . . is their inheritance as He promised them
verses.literalPt: Por isso não terão herança no meio de seus irmãos; o SENHOR é a sua herança, como lhes tem dito.

verses.original: וְזֶ֡ה יִהְיֶה֩ מִשְׁפַּ֨ט הַכֹּהֲנִ֜ים מֵאֵ֣ת הָעָ֗ם מֵאֵ֛ת זֹבְחֵ֥י הַזֶּ֖בַח אִם־ שׁ֣וֹר אִם־ שֶׂ֑ה וְנָתַן֙ לַכֹּהֵ֔ן הַזְּרֹ֥עַ וְהַלְּחָיַ֖יִם וְהַקֵּבָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·zeh yih·yeh miš·paṭ hak·kō·hă·nîm mê·’êṯ hā·‘ām mê·’êṯ zō·ḇə·ḥê haz·ze·ḇaḥ ’im- šō·wr ’im- śeh wə·nā·ṯan lak·kō·hên haz·zə·rō·a‘ wə·hal·lə·ḥā·ya·yim wə·haq·qê·ḇāh
verses.literal: This shall be the priests’ . . . share from the people . . . who offer a sacrifice whether a bull or a sheep the priests are to be given the shoulder the jowls and the stomach
verses.literalPt: Este, pois, será o direito dos sacerdotes, a receber do povo, dos que oferecerem sacrifício, seja boi ou gado miúdo; que darão ao sacerdote a espádua e as queixadas e o bucho.

verses.original: רֵאשִׁ֨ית דְּגָֽנְךָ֜ תִּֽירֹשְׁךָ֣ וְיִצְהָרֶ֗ךָ וְרֵאשִׁ֛ית גֵּ֥ז צֹאנְךָ֖ תִּתֶּן־ לּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: rê·šîṯ də·ḡā·nə·ḵā tî·rō·šə·ḵā wə·yiṣ·hā·re·ḵā wə·rê·šîṯ gêz ṣō·nə·ḵā tit·ten- lōw
verses.literal: You are to give them the firstfruits of your grain new wine and oil and the first wool sheared from your flock
verses.literalPt: Dar-lhe-ás as primícias do teu grão, do teu mosto e do teu azeite, e as primícias da tosquia das tuas ovelhas.

verses.original: כִּ֣י ב֗וֹ בָּחַ֛ר יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ מִכָּל־ שְׁבָטֶ֑יךָ לַעֲמֹ֨ד לְשָׁרֵ֧ת בְּשֵׁם־ יְהוָ֛ה ה֥וּא וּבָנָ֖יו כָּל־ הַיָּמִֽים׃ס
verses.transliteration: kî ḇōw bā·ḥar Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā mik·kāl šə·ḇā·ṭe·ḵā la·‘ă·mōḏ lə·šā·rêṯ bə·šêm- Yah·weh hū ū·ḇā·nāw kāl- hay·yā·mîm
verses.literal: For the LORD your God has chosen Levi and his sons out of all your tribes to stand and minister in His . . . name for all time
verses.literalPt: Porque o SENHOR teu Deus o escolheu de todas as tuas tribos, para que assista e sirva no nome do SENHOR, ele e seus filhos, todos os dias.

verses.original: וְכִֽי־ יָבֹ֨א הַלֵּוִ֜י מֵאַחַ֤ד שְׁעָרֶ֙יךָ֙ מִכָּל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֲשֶׁר־ ה֖וּא גָּ֣ר שָׁ֑ם וּבָא֙ בְּכָל־ אַוַּ֣ת נַפְשׁ֔וֹ אֶל־ הַמָּק֖וֹם אֲשֶׁר־ יִבְחַ֥ר יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵî- yā·ḇō hal·lê·wî mê·’a·ḥaḏ šə·‘ā·re·ḵā mik·kāl yiś·rā·’êl ’ă·šer- hū gār šām ū·ḇā bə·ḵāl ’aw·waṯ nap̄·šōw ’el- ham·mā·qō·wm ’ă·šer- yiḇ·ḥar Yah·weh
verses.literal: Now if a Levite moves from any town . . . of residence throughout Israel and comes in all earnestness . . . to the place the LORD will choose
verses.literalPt: E, quando chegar um levita de alguma das tuas portas, de todo o Israel, onde habitar; e vier com todo o desejo da sua alma ao lugar que o SENHOR escolheu;

verses.original: וְשֵׁרֵ֕ת בְּשֵׁ֖ם יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהָ֑יו כְּכָל־ אֶחָיו֙ הַלְוִיִּ֔ם הָעֹמְדִ֥ים שָׁ֖ם לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·šê·rêṯ bə·šêm Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hāw kə·ḵāl- ’e·ḥāw hal·wî·yim hā·‘ō·mə·ḏîm šām lip̄·nê Yah·weh
verses.literal: then he shall serve in the name of the LORD his God like all his fellow Levites who stand there before the LORD
verses.literalPt: E servir no nome do SENHOR seu Deus, como também todos os seus irmãos, os levitas, que assistem ali perante o SENHOR,

verses.original: חֵ֥לֶק כְּחֵ֖לֶק יֹאכֵ֑לוּ לְבַ֥ד מִמְכָּרָ֖יו עַל־ הָאָבֽוֹת׃ס
verses.transliteration: ḥê·leq kə·ḥê·leq yō·ḵê·lū lə·ḇaḏ mim·kā·rāw ‘al- hā·’ā·ḇō·wṯ
verses.literal: They shall eat equal portions . . . even though he has received money from the sale of his father’s estate
verses.literalPt: Igual porção comerão, além das vendas do seu patrimônio.

verses.original: כִּ֤י אַתָּה֙ בָּ֣א אֶל־ הָאָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁר־ יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ נֹתֵ֣ן לָ֑ךְ לֹֽא־ תִלְמַ֣ד לַעֲשׂ֔וֹת כְּתוֹעֲבֹ֖ת הַגּוֹיִ֥ם הָהֵֽם׃
verses.transliteration: kî ’at·tāh bā ’el- hā·’ā·reṣ ’ă·šer- Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā nō·ṯên lāḵ lō- ṯil·maḏ la·‘ă·śō·wṯ kə·ṯō·w·‘ă·ḇōṯ hag·gō·w·yim hā·hêm
verses.literal: When you enter . . . the land that the LORD your God is giving you do not . . . imitate the detestable ways of the nations there
verses.literalPt: Quando entrares na terra que o SENHOR teu Deus te der, não aprenderás a fazer conforme as abominações daquelas nações.

verses.original: לֹֽא־ יִמָּצֵ֣א בְךָ֔ מַעֲבִ֥יר בְּנֽוֹ־ וּבִתּ֖וֹ בָּאֵ֑שׁ קֹסֵ֣ם קְסָמִ֔ים מְעוֹנֵ֥ן וּמְנַחֵ֖שׁ וּמְכַשֵּֽׁף׃
verses.transliteration: lō- yim·mā·ṣê ḇə·ḵā ma·‘ă·ḇîr bə·nōw- ū·ḇit·tōw bā·’êš qō·sêm qə·sā·mîm mə·‘ō·w·nên ū·mə·na·ḥêš ū·mə·ḵaš·šêp̄
verses.literal: Let no one be found among you who sacrifices his son or daughter in the fire practices divination . . . or conjury interprets omens practices sorcery
verses.literalPt: Entre ti não se achará quem faça passar pelo fogo a seu filho ou a sua filha, nem adivinhador, nem prognosticador, nem agoureiro, nem feiticeiro;

verses.original: וְחֹבֵ֖ר חָ֑בֶר וְשֹׁאֵ֥ל אוֹב֙ וְיִדְּעֹנִ֔י וְדֹרֵ֖שׁ אֶל־ הַמֵּתִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḥō·ḇêr ḥā·ḇer wə·šō·’êl ’ō·wḇ wə·yid·də·‘ō·nî wə·ḏō·rêš ’el- ham·mê·ṯîm
verses.literal: casts spells . . . consults a medium or spiritist or inquires of the dead
verses.literalPt: Nem encantador, nem quem consulte a um espírito adivinhador, nem mágico, nem quem consulte os mortos;

verses.original: כִּֽי־ תוֹעֲבַ֥ת יְהוָ֖ה כָּל־ עֹ֣שֵׂה אֵ֑לֶּה וּבִגְלַל֙ הַתּוֹעֵבֹ֣ת הָאֵ֔לֶּה יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ מוֹרִ֥ישׁ אוֹתָ֖ם מִפָּנֶֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: kî- ṯō·w·‘ă·ḇaṯ Yah·weh kāl- ‘ō·śêh ’êl·leh ū·ḇiḡ·lal hat·tō·w·‘ê·ḇōṯ hā·’êl·leh Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā mō·w·rîš ’ō·w·ṯām mip·pā·ne·ḵā
verses.literal: For whoever does these things is detestable to the LORD And because of these detestable things the LORD your God is driving out the nations before you
verses.literalPt: Pois todo aquele que faz tal coisa é abominação ao SENHOR; e por estas abominações o SENHOR teu Deus os lança fora de diante de ti.

verses.original: תָּמִ֣ים תִּֽהְיֶ֔ה עִ֖ם יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶֽיךָ׃ס
verses.transliteration: tā·mîm tih·yeh ‘im Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā
verses.literal: You must be blameless before the LORD your God
verses.literalPt: Perfeito serás, como o SENHOR teu Deus.

verses.original: כִּ֣י׀ הַגּוֹיִ֣ם הָאֵ֗לֶּה אֲשֶׁ֤ר אַתָּה֙ יוֹרֵ֣שׁ אוֹתָ֔ם אֶל־ מְעֹנְנִ֥ים וְאֶל־ קֹסְמִ֖ים יִשְׁמָ֑עוּ וְאַתָּ֕ה לֹ֣א כֵ֔ן נָ֛תַן לְךָ֖ יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: kî hag·gō·w·yim hā·’êl·leh ’ă·šer ’at·tāh yō·w·rêš ’ō·w·ṯām ’el- mə·‘ō·nə·nîm wə·’el- qō·sə·mîm yiš·mā·‘ū wə·’at·tāh lō ḵên nå̄·ṯan lə·ḵā Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā
verses.literal: Though these nations which you will dispossess listen . . . to conjurers . . . and diviners the LORD your God has not permitted you to do so
verses.literalPt: Porque estas nações, que hás de possuir, ouvem os prognosticadores e os adivinhadores; porém a ti o SENHOR teu Deus não permitiu tal coisa.

verses.original: נָבִ֨יא מִקִּרְבְּךָ֤ מֵאַחֶ֙יךָ֙ כָּמֹ֔נִי יָקִ֥ים לְךָ֖ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֑יךָ אֵלָ֖יו תִּשְׁמָעֽוּן׃
verses.transliteration: nā·ḇî miq·qir·bə·ḵā mê·’a·ḥe·ḵā kā·mō·nî yā·qîm lə·ḵā Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā ’ê·lāw tiš·mā·‘ūn
verses.literal: The LORD your God will raise up for you a prophet like me from among your brothers You must listen to him
verses.literalPt: O SENHOR teu Deus te levantará um profeta do meio de ti, de teus irmãos, como eu; a ele ouvireis;

verses.original: כְּכֹ֨ל אֲשֶׁר־ שָׁאַ֜לְתָּ מֵעִ֨ם יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֶ֙יךָ֙ בְּחֹרֵ֔ב בְּי֥וֹם הַקָּהָ֖ל לֵאמֹ֑ר לֹ֣א אֹסֵ֗ף לִשְׁמֹ֙עַ֙ אֶת־ קוֹל֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהָ֔י וְאֶת־ הָאֵ֨שׁ הַגְּדֹלָ֥ה הַזֹּ֛את לֹֽא־ אֶרְאֶ֥ה ע֖וֹד וְלֹ֥א אָמֽוּת׃
verses.transliteration: kə·ḵōl ’ă·šer- šā·’al·tā mê·‘im Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā bə·ḥō·rêḇ bə·yō·wm haq·qā·hāl lê·mōr lō ’ō·sêp̄ liš·mō·a‘ ’eṯ- qō·wl Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hāy wə·’eṯ- hā·’êš hag·gə·ḏō·lāh haz·zōṯ lō- ’er·’eh ‘ō·wḏ wə·lō ’ā·mūṯ
verses.literal: This is what you asked of the LORD your God at Horeb on the day of the assembly when you said Let us not hear the voice of the LORD our God or see this great fire anymore so that we will not die
verses.literalPt: Conforme a tudo o que pediste ao SENHOR teu Deus em Horebe, no dia da assembléia, dizendo: Não ouvirei mais a voz do SENHOR teu Deus, nem mais verei este grande fogo, para que não morra.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר יְהוָ֖ה אֵלָ֑י הֵיטִ֖יבוּ אֲשֶׁ֥ר דִּבֵּֽרוּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer Yah·weh ’ê·lāy hê·ṭî·ḇū ’ă·šer dib·bê·rū
verses.literal: Then the LORD said to me They have spoken well
verses.literalPt: Então o SENHOR me disse: Falaram bem naquilo que disseram.

verses.original: נָבִ֨יא אָקִ֥ים לָהֶ֛ם מִקֶּ֥רֶב אֲחֵיהֶ֖ם כָּמ֑וֹךָ וְנָתַתִּ֤י דְבָרַי֙ בְּפִ֔יו וְדִבֶּ֣ר אֲלֵיהֶ֔ם אֵ֖ת כָּל־ אֲשֶׁ֥ר אֲצַוֶּֽנּוּ׃
verses.transliteration: nā·ḇî ’ā·qîm lā·hem miq·qe·reḇ ’ă·ḥê·hem kā·mō·w·ḵā wə·nā·ṯat·tî ḏə·ḇā·ray bə·p̄îw wə·ḏib·ber ’ă·lê·hem ’êṯ kāl- ’ă·šer ’ă·ṣaw·wen·nū
verses.literal: I will raise up . . . for them a prophet like you from among their brothers I will put My words in his mouth and he will tell them everything I command him
verses.literalPt: Eis lhes suscitarei um profeta do meio de seus irmãos, como tu, e porei as minhas palavras na sua boca, e ele lhes falará tudo o que eu lhe ordenar.

verses.original: וְהָיָ֗ה הָאִישׁ֙ אֲשֶׁ֤ר לֹֽא־ יִשְׁמַע֙ אֶל־ דְּבָרַ֔י אֲשֶׁ֥ר יְדַבֵּ֖ר בִּשְׁמִ֑י אָנֹכִ֖י אֶדְרֹ֥שׁ מֵעִמּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh hā·’îš ’ă·šer lō- yiš·ma‘ ’el- də·ḇā·ray ’ă·šer yə·ḏab·bêr biš·mî ’ā·nō·ḵî ’eḏ·rōš mê·‘im·mōw
verses.literal: And I will hold accountable . . . anyone who does not listen to My words that the prophet speaks in My name
verses.literalPt: E será que qualquer que não ouvir as minhas palavras, que ele falar em meu nome, eu o requererei dele.

verses.original: אַ֣ךְ הַנָּבִ֡יא אֲשֶׁ֣ר יָזִיד֩ לְדַבֵּ֨ר דָּבָ֜ר בִּשְׁמִ֗י אֵ֣ת אֲשֶׁ֤ר לֹֽא־ צִוִּיתִיו֙ לְדַבֵּ֔ר וַאֲשֶׁ֣ר יְדַבֵּ֔ר בְּשֵׁ֖ם אֱלֹהִ֣ים אֲחֵרִ֑ים וּמֵ֖ת הַנָּבִ֥יא הַהֽוּא׃
verses.transliteration: ’aḵ han·nā·ḇî ’ă·šer yā·zîḏ lə·ḏab·bêr dā·ḇār biš·mî ’êṯ ’ă·šer lō- ṣiw·wî·ṯîw lə·ḏab·bêr wa·’ă·šer yə·ḏab·bêr bə·šêm ’ĕ·lō·hîm ’ă·ḥê·rîm ū·mêṯ han·nā·ḇî ha·hū
verses.literal: But if any prophet dares to speak a message in My name that I have not commanded him to speak or to speak in the name of other gods that prophet must be put to death
verses.literalPt: Porém o profeta que tiver a presunção de falar alguma palavra em meu nome, que eu não lhe tenha mandado falar, ou o que falar em nome de outros deuses, esse profeta morrerá.

verses.original: וְכִ֥י תֹאמַ֖ר בִּלְבָבֶ֑ךָ אֵיכָה֙ נֵדַ֣ע אֶת־ הַדָּבָ֔ר אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹא־ דִבְּר֖וֹ יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵî ṯō·mar bil·ḇā·ḇe·ḵā ’ê·ḵāh nê·ḏa‘ ’eṯ- had·dā·ḇār ’ă·šer lō- ḏib·bə·rōw Yah·weh
verses.literal: You may ask in your heart How can we recognize a message that the LORD has not spoken
verses.literalPt: E, se disseres no teu coração: Como conhecerei a palavra que o SENHOR não falou?

verses.original: אֲשֶׁר֩ יְדַבֵּ֨ר הַנָּבִ֜יא בְּשֵׁ֣ם יְהוָ֗ה וְלֹֽא־ יִהְיֶ֤ה הַדָּבָר֙ וְלֹ֣א יָב֔וֹא ה֣וּא הַדָּבָ֔ר אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹא־ דִבְּר֖וֹ יְהוָ֑ה בְּזָדוֹן֙ דִּבְּר֣וֹ הַנָּבִ֔יא לֹ֥א תָג֖וּר מִמֶּֽנּוּ׃ס
verses.transliteration: ’ă·šer yə·ḏab·bêr han·nā·ḇî bə·šêm Yah·weh wə·lō- yih·yeh had·dā·ḇār wə·lō yā·ḇō·w hū had·dā·ḇār ’ă·šer lō- ḏib·bə·rōw Yah·weh bə·zā·ḏō·wn dib·bə·rōw han·nā·ḇî lō ṯā·ḡūr mim·men·nū
verses.literal: When a prophet speaks in the name of the LORD and the message does not come to pass or come true that is a message the LORD has not spoken The prophet has spoken presumptuously Do not be afraid of him
verses.literalPt: Quando o profeta falar em nome do SENHOR, e essa palavra não se cumprir, nem suceder assim; esta é palavra que o SENHOR não falou; com soberba a falou aquele profeta; não tenhas temor dele.
